System

Guild membership, roles and durable social administration

Guilds provide durable membership, roles, invitations and guild chat after basic parties/economy operate safely. Initial guilds do not include a guild bank, territory simulation or monetization.

Scope and player interaction

Guilds provide durable membership, roles, invitations and guild chat after basic parties/economy operate safely. Initial guilds do not include a guild bank, territory simulation or monetization.

StageMeaning
First integration: Phase21committed; full feature contract may include explicitly staged later extensions
EvidenceAuthored implementation specification; no native/Blueprint/backend runtime verified

UI state machine

NoGuild → InvitePending → Member → Officer → Leader → Leaving → Disbanded

WBP_Guild observes results from URPGGuildComponent. Pending is not Accepted. Close/cancel clears local focus and stale callbacks, but cannot undo an already committed backend command.

Definitions, fields and units

Canonical definition: DA_GuildPolicy_Default. Stable IDs, quantities, seconds and centimeters are validated by the owner, not inferred from translated labels or sprites.

Field / rule
GuildId UUID; NameNormalized; GuildRevision
Membership: one guild per character initially; unique membership record
Role: Member|Officer|Leader with explicit capability matrix
InviteId/Expiry and inviter capability
LeadershipTransferId: authenticated explicit operation, audit record
GuildChatPermission: membership/moderation/block policy

C++ / Blueprint / backend ownership

LayerResponsibility
URPGGuildComponentImplement the native validated request/state lifecycle described below; native runtime state is not editable by UMG.
Blueprint/Data AssetsTune the declared defaults and visual/asset assignments. Keep definition references EditDefaultsOnly/BlueprintReadOnly; cosmetic hooks cannot grant rewards.
Zone serverValidate live actor ownership, range/LOS, alive/action state, cooldown/tool/target rules and current session epoch where relevant.
BackendFor durable changes, revalidate trusted catalog/revision/ownership and commit records/source claims/receipt atomically. Read-only/cosmetic features have no durable mutation.
WBP_GuildLocal observer/requester. Create only for local player; bind once, refresh immediately, unbind on teardown.

Custom command contracts

These names are project custom APIs or backend proposals, not existing Unreal/PaperZD nodes. Economic/backend requests are asynchronous; Pending resolves through the same command ID. Pure local queries are synchronous unless noted.

Command / result
CreateGuild(CommandId, Name, CharterPolicy) -> Created|NameUnavailable|RequirementsFailed
InviteGuildMember(CommandId, TargetId) -> Invited|Forbidden|Blocked
ChangeGuildRole(CommandId, MemberId, NewRole, ExpectedRevision) -> Updated|Forbidden
LeaveGuild(CommandId) -> Left|LeaderTransferRequired
TransferGuildLeadership(CommandId, MemberId) -> Transferred|Forbidden

End-to-end command and observation flow

  1. Authenticated eligible character creates a unique named guild under moderated naming rules and receives leader role in one transaction.
  2. Invitations verify officer capabilities and target block/membership constraints; acceptance creates one membership.
  3. Every role/kick/disband/leadership mutation validates capability and revision on backend, not a visible UI button alone.
  4. Zone/social projections publish guild tag/name and authorized member list; private account IDs remain hidden.
  5. Guild chat reuses moderated chat routing; membership changes invalidate delivery rights promptly.
  6. Disconnect/restart preserves roles and pending invitation policy. Leader departure requires explicit transfer/recovery rather than accidental orphaning.

Editor configuration and real consumers

  1. Create guild schema and capability matrix, DA_GuildPolicy_Default and GuildFixture_Riverwatch.
  2. Build WBP_Guild with roster, role labels, invites, leave and explicit leadership confirmation.
  3. Reopen chat/nameplates/social service for guild-safe public metadata and channel permissions.
  4. Add moderator recovery procedure for abandoned leadership with audit and appeal policy; do not create an unaudited admin override in client Blueprint.
  5. Test role escalation, stale revision, last leader and duplicate name cases.

Reopen Phase21 integration entries after creating the assets. Test fixture: GuildFixture_Riverwatch / Officer_A / Member_B. No later-phase runtime dependency should be activated before its recorded integration phase.

Failure, contention and recovery acceptance

Test stimulus and expected result
Member forges officer role RPC -> Forbidden.
Two leadership changes race -> one valid revision result.
Leader leaves without successor -> LeaderTransferRequired.
Blocked/private data leaked via guild lookup -> security test failure.

Repeat the success route with two clients when networking exists, then disconnect immediately before/after a committed result. Query the same command and compare authoritative snapshot/receipt with UI. Restart the relevant zone, reject stale epochs, and rerun the previous phase route. Pure visual/input features instead verify cleanup and unchanged server facts. These are future test recipes, not reported passes.

Tuning, accessibility and observability

Initial cap 30 members is a proposal, not a scalability result. Guild bank/housing/raids remain separate optional expansions with additional economy/operations gates.

Audit role/membership changes and moderator interventions. Guild UI supports list navigation, text scaling and clear destructive-action confirmations.

Art gaps, production and do-not-build-yet

The asset ZIP and installed PaperZD APIs remain unverified. Required new art/unsupported layer combinations are tracked in art/animation-matrix.html and art/equipment-visual-matrix.html. A legal debug visual can prove authority but is not finished content. Production features listed as later/optional remain disabled until their phase/gate passes.
